title: Low Berth
backstory:
A backdrop. Not a plot.
Small scenarios. Self-contained.

Ships of every size.
Only a few decks seen.
Some crew. A robot.
Whoever paid passage.

No message outruns ships.
News is old.
Nobody calls for help.

Low berth: frozen, cheap.
Wake among strangers.

Stunners, not guns.
Robots notice things.
A few read minds.
They keep quiet.

Nothing fixed. Add freely.
voice:
Plain. Practical.
Decks, watches, berths, ports.
Dry humour.
No speeches.
